settings.heading: Craft over spectacle
settings.text: Every silhouette is cut for the body that will wear it, not the camera that might catch it. We edit until only the necessary line remains.

settings.heading: Material honesty
settings.text: Cloth is chosen for hand and age: how it falls in late light, how it will look after a hundred evenings. Hardware is quiet. Linings are finished as if they might be seen.

settings.heading: Quiet luxury
settings.text: Maison Tavo does not chase a calendar of drops for their own sake. We open the atelier when a story is complete, and we close it when the edition is spoken for.

settings.heading: Maison Tavo
settings.lede: A house of considered objects, made to be lived with and remembered. We work slowly, in small editions, for people who prefer presence to noise.
settings.closing: Maison Tavo is not a season. It is a wardrobe built in chapters — each piece a quiet argument for lasting form.
